updates.title: Mini Update
items: Tower: lower rolls that still grow as you climb; floors past 1,000 are harder; Hard mode gives ~1.5x Normal rewards
Battles: buffs now show live on card stats; Slime Demon Lord deck damage +8% (was 3.6%); fixed wrong card picture sometimes showing
Supports: equip multiple copies + drag & drop, same as attack cards
Boss drops: world end bosses 10% card drop; timed world bosses 3-5% card drop
Guild Planets: FIGHT runs through every guard team back to back with no healing; losing = 30 min wait; only 1 member can attack at a time; progress resets after 5h
Guild Planets: each guild sees its own DEFEATED teams; 5 min shield after a capture; leaders + officers can abandon planets; new planet map, VIEW TEAM button, full guild names
Guilds: new glow look on every screen, icons/tiles/chips for power, gems, boss rewards and planet buffs, instant donating with a coin sound, new rank medals, bigger menu for phones + iPads
Guilds fixes: overlapping text/buttons, crown covering LEADER, jumping button icons, typed text not showing, member count after leaving, flash when switching systems

iPad / Tablet: proper tablet sizes; bigger side/top buttons, leaderboard, VIP + DASH; roll bar, auto-roll preview, Card Grader, Titles + Guild menus sized for tablets; SHOW BATTLE no longer flashes during hidden auto-climb
Climb bars: sit in the top bar on phone + PC and move aside for the leaderboard; fixed STOP button not clickable; Shard Tower bar hides when a menu opens
Less lag in menus, card lists, pickups and bosses
